title: JVanilla Spiced Ancho Chile Quesadilla
description: A resinous, springy, adventurous Mexican dish featuring ancho chiles and vanilla extract, perfect for a vegetarian-friendly snack or light meal served in a tandoor-clay-pot.
instructions: Toast the ancho chiles under a low broiler for about 1 minute on each side until fragrant and lightly charred.
Blend the toasted ancho chiles with the salt, vanilla extract, adobo sauce, and lime juice in a blender or food processor.
Heat the oil in the pot over medium heat. Add the blended mixture and stir to combine well.
Dust the surface of each tortilla lightly with flour.
Place a tortilla flat on a work surface; top with about 1/4 cup of the ancho chile sauce, then sprinkle with salt.
Fold the other side of the tortilla over the filling and press down gently to seal.
Place the quesadilla in the pot, seam-side up, and cook for about 3 minutes until golden brown on the underside.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until both sides are crispy and golden.
Serve hot and enjoy the resinous, springy, adventurous flavor of this vegetarian-friendly dish.
